contract: A calm control-room dashboard for daily cron monitoring: search monitors, filter by status, and open a monitor detail with its heartbeat command. Targets 390x844 and 1440x1000, HeroUI only, keyboard and reduced motion.

accessibility.evidence: Search input and status filters are labelled; interactive cards are buttons with aria-pressed; focus rings, contrast tokens and reduced-motion rules are applied globally.

responsive.evidence: Desktop and mobile captures show the sidebar collapsing to a header, filters wrapping, and long labels truncating without overflow.

loading.evidence: Dashboard shows stable skeleton rows without layout shift.

empty.evidence: Empty state explains the missing data and links to monitor creation.

error.evidence: Error state names the failure and offers a retry action.

partial.reason: The v2 dashboard returns whole monitors or none; no partial data slice exists yet.

success.evidence: A populated monitor detail renders status, configuration and heartbeat command after creation.

permission.reason: Unauthenticated users are redirected to login before a permission-specific screen is needed.

renderedEvidence.observation: Search, status summary filters and monitor list are visible in one pass.
Detail page shows status header, heartbeat command, incidents and configuration.
Mobile layout collapses navigation and keeps search and status filters reachable.
